prompt: Write a Python module that handles rate limiting for an API client. It should support sliding window and token bucket algorithms. This is for a mid-level developer working on a mature SaaS codebase.

assertions.name: naming_diversity
assertions.description: Uses a mix of abbreviated and descriptive names

assertions.name: comment_authenticity
assertions.description: Comments explain WHY not WHAT, includes TODO/HACK/ticket refs

assertions.name: structural_variance
assertions.description: Function lengths vary, not all same template shape

assertions.name: no_over_documentation
assertions.description: No formulaic docstrings on trivial methods
